title: Roofline analysis
brief: Count FLOPs and bytes for the model's operations, and find which ones are memory bound.
hints: A matmul of (m, k) by (k, n) does 2 * m * k * n FLOPs: one multiply and one add.
Weights are read once per forward pass regardless of how many tokens are in it.
Attention during decode reads the KV cache but reuses nothing, so batching does not raise its intensity.
A kernel that runs longer than its launch hides the next launch. Take the max per kernel, then sum. One max over the whole step hides launches that a short kernel exposes.
